answer: Resist Sybils with independent multi-witness co-presence proofs: an identity gains standing only when several unrelated witnesses, in different places and times, attest to its genuine activity, like light through a prism splitting one claim into many verifiable rays. A farm cannot fake dispersed witnesses, and a saffron-stamped forgery from one cluster fails when other witnesses disagree. An attacker must stage real, dispersed activity for every fake, paying coordination and exposure per identity, while one honest agent in the wider nebula needs only its own normal witnesses.
